scenes.text: Consulting slides do *one* thing yours don't
scenes.say: [knowing] Consulting slides do one thing yours don't.

scenes.title: Revenue by region
scenes.say: [casual] It's the title. Most decks title this slide... revenue by region. [beat] [emphatic] But partners? They write the answer. [confident] APAC drove 70% of growth.

scenes.label: The three-second test
scenes.title: APAC drove *70%* of growth
scenes.say: [conversational] Here's the test. Is it a full sentence? Does it make one claim? [pointed] And does the chart actually prove it?

titles: Margins held despite the price cuts
So we double down on APAC *now*
scenes.say: [thoughtful] Then read only your titles, top to bottom. [warm] If they tell the whole story on their own... you've nailed it.
[upbeat] Answer, not topic. One claim per title. Titles that tell the story. [playful] Now go check your last slide title.
